reason: A third-party DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary purpose is reading assistant replies aloud using Fish Audio text-to-speech, with manual and automatic playback controls plus configurable API access.

summaries.zh: 通过 Fish Audio 文本转语音 API 将 DeepSeek Harness 的助手回复朗读出来，并提供手动朗读、自动朗读及语音设置功能。
summaries.en: Reads DeepSeek Harness assistant replies aloud through the Fish Audio text-to-speech API with manual playback, auto-read, and voice settings.

capabilities: Converts selected assistant replies into speech through the Fish Audio API
Automatically reads newly generated replies when enabled
Stores Fish Audio configuration and an API key locally
Plays synthesized audio and supports model, voice, format, and proxy settings
